prompt:
Generate one high-quality cinematic 16:9 image for the specified section, not a generic slide or dashboard. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Do not invent a completed publication, a live security test, a solved outing, approval or consensus. Fictional editorial staging, not documentary evidence. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
VISUAL FORMAT: bounded-choice-tableau
TEACHING PURPOSE: Make the viewer choose between completion, unauthorized change and one permitted check.
CAMERA: Direct overhead view of a pause before choosing.
Overhead editorial photograph of a walnut planning table with three distinct, unmarked objects arranged as a wide triangle: closed cream folio at upper-left, a small blank notepad at lower-left, and an unused plain brass paperweight at right. A volunteer's hands pause at the bottom edge, touching none of them. Warm neutral daylight, no moral red/green coloring, no text, diagrams, pens writing, signatures or tick marks. The central area remains clear for a three-way SVG choice composition. No action has been selected or booking changed.
COMPOSITING INTENT: Three large verbs form a triangular choice, with one explicit grant boundary below. Equal treatment prevents the answer being signaled by color.
SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: FICTIONAL ENGINEERING VARIANT. You may check one alternative time with the venue. You may not change the booking. Do you mark the task complete, reschedule it, or make that bounded check? Choose, and name the authority your choice requires. Pause here if you need time.
